items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the Shah was sitting there (in) the front row with all the dignitaries in line... the Shah went from John to me to Jackson to Connie down the line congratulating us

ctx.x: “Under the Jasmine Tree” was part of the documentary?
Right, and so was this other theme. There was another theme on there that I can’t recall the name of it. That music was written for that, and you know the story about the Shah of Iran.
